how_to_add: Add one block to campaigns, in the order the cards should show. The page draws each block as its own card.
name: the campaign. hub: the core piece. kind is what it is (Blog, Webinar, Event, Press release, Report), title and date, plus link if there is one.
For visits, give hub.visits_path (an opsera.ai path) and the page counts Google Analytics visits from hub.date, or to visits_to if given. Or give hub.number as text.
spokes: each has group (Format or Channel) and name, plus link, visits_path or number as text.
source is the line under the card. numbers_note says where the numbers came from and when.
Never put people's emails or a single customer's deal in this file: it is public.

campaigns.name: PHP2Shell

hub.title: PHP2Shell: Invisible Threats and What to Do Next

campaigns.numbers_note: LinkedIn numbers from the company page export to 7 Nov and Kumar's post list; email numbers from HubSpot, as given on 6 Nov 2026. Visits from Google Analytics, opsera.ai only, from 26 Oct.
